ModMetaData.name: Just Start
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
You configure the game. Just Start deals you the hand.
Choose your scenario, storyteller, difficulty and world settings as normal, then click Just Start instead of Generate. The world is generated, a random starting site is picked, weighted by biome like the "Select random site" button, and you start with the scenario's colonists as they come. No site hunting, no rerolling.
Right-click the Just Start button for its settings: - Exclude extreme biomes: never start in a biome the game warns about when settling, such as ice sheet or extreme desert. Off by default. - Ideoligion mode: classic, random fixed, random fluid, or classic mode for every faction. Requires Ideology.
Works with any scenario, including modded ones.
